# proxmox_guest_unlink (Resource)

Unlinks disks from a QEMU guest config through `PUT /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/unlink` without deleting the underlying volumes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_guest_unlink" "detach" {
  node     = "pve"
  vmid     = 100
  idlist   = ["scsi1"]
  triggers = { revision = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `idlist` (List of String)
- `node` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
